overview_description.description: Hydrexa is a climate technology company focused on addressing water scarcity and sustainable cooling through advanced engineering and material science. The company develops atmospheric water harvesting and dehumidification technologies that extract water vapor from the air to generate clean drinking water while also improving cooling efficiency and reducing energy consumption.
